subject: Windows scalar message codec and socket header contract
authority: Original Windows x86; current source names describe inferred fields. Runtime offsets and unsigned long width belong to the Windows ABI.

reproduce.implementation: Unicorn executes original and rebuilt bodies, including their real scalar callees. Reccmp resolves current PDB addresses and reads PE images. The existing original reference hash is checked.

scalar_contract.wire_order: Big endian; exactly 4, 2 or 1 bytes. Use explicit format widths in a separate port, independent of host unsigned long.
scalar_contract.add: Store low argument bytes at descending destination offsets; reload this+0x1c between stores. Advance the current write cursor by the scalar width.
scalar_contract.get_reference: Read descending source offsets into ascending result bytes; reload this+0x20 between stores. Advance the current read cursor by the scalar width.
scalar_contract.get_value: Call the reference overload with a stack temporary. DWORD returns EAX; WORD and BYTE define only AX and AL respectively.
scalar_contract.convert_dword: Capture bytes 0 and 1; copy byte 3 to 0, then byte 2 to 1; write captured bytes to 2 and 3. Reload the read cursor between stores; advance by four.
scalar_contract.convert_word: Capture bytes 1 and 0; write captured byte 0 to offset 1, then captured byte 1 to offset 0. Reload the cursor before the second store; advance by two.
scalar_contract.convert_byte: Advance the read cursor by one; no payload write.
scalar_contract.abi: This in ECX. Add/reference-Get consume one four-byte stack slot and RET 4. Value-Get/Convert have no stack arguments. Callee-saved registers preserved.
scalar_contract.bounds: No length or end-pointer checks in these scalar bodies. Fixture buffers are mapped and sufficiently large; malformed-input policy remains separate work.

socket_header.add: Load the header pointer at this+0x2c and each field immediately before its scalar Add call. Earlier stores can affect later field loads in controlled overlap cases.
socket_header.get: Convert the first two DWORDs and three WORDs in place, then advance past the critical byte. Resulting multi-byte fields use Windows little-endian order.
socket_header.byte_15: Neither codec reads or writes this byte. No zero value or protocol meaning established. Packet assembly still copies a 16-byte header.

fixture_vector.qualification: Constructed codec vector, not a captured valid network packet. Final a5 is a preserved sentinel.

socket_header.receive_boundary: Current CReadSocket::ProcessPacket calls Set on scratch storage before inspecting header fields or dispatching packet assembly. Set invokes virtual GetHeader/GetData. docs/packet-assembly.json describes the later assembly boundary; the end-to-end receive lifecycle is not exercised here.

checks: Complete 64 KiB heap and ordered heap write addresses, widths and values agree with the native model in both images.
Scalar return widths, thiscall cleanup and preserved registers agree.
All 256 byte values; wider edge/random values; aligned and unaligned buffers; selected output/source and cursor-field aliases.
Both socket codecs advance by 15 and preserve the following byte.
Every original instruction in the 14 bodies executes across the fixtures.

limits_and_remaining_work: Finite fixtures; no argument-stack aliasing, live network, complete packet lifecycle or universal equivalence claim.
Controlled native aliases establish sensitivity to access timing, not that normal game callers create those aliases or that portable C++ must admit them.
Trace CopyDataStream/Set callers, buffer owners and lifetimes before simplifying cursor access. CopyDataStream assigns buffer/cursors without resetting the ownership flag.
Distinguish serialized widths from runtime pointers and native class layout in a separate port.
Still needed: string/blob codecs, complete packet traces, pointer-token lifecycle, retry/discovery/disconnect and allocation-failure behavior.
SDL dependencies and backend implementation belong in a separate repository.
